title: Separate an exact information coefficient from a normalized physical inverse
statement: On S=supp(sum tau_i), let Pi_i project onto ker(sum_{j!=i}tau_j), r_i=Tr(tau_i Pi_i). The accepted exact r=min r_i controls J_out>=r J_input, including changing reference marginals, not just D_out>=r D_input. For positive r_i the Hilbert-Schmidt extraction E_i=Pi_i/r_i pays both left/right modular families and reference subtraction. Its effects need not form one POVM. Actual completed B/Cwhole reviews qualify the corrected final source at this scope.
